title: Worktree federation for symbol lookup (#44)
summary: Cymbal scopes each repo's DB by workdir (`git rev-parse --show-toplevel` equivalent — `FindGitRoot` walks up to a `.git` dir or file). For git worktrees, `.git` is a *file* with `gitdir:` pointing into the main repo, so the worktree's path is unique and hashes to its own DB.
constraints: No schema migration — per-worktree DBs remain the storage unit
No cross-worktree graph traversal (impact/trace/impls/refs stay within seed's DB)
No auto-index of foreign worktrees — unindexed siblings emit a stderr note and are skipped
Non-worktree repos must run no git worktree commands (zero overhead path)
Federation fan-out capped at 32 worktrees with stderr note

title: Per-symbol body hash: detect whether a symbol changed
summary: cymbal has no way to say "this function is the same as it was". The internal SymbolID (index/store.go:650-653, rel_path:lang:kind:name:start_line) is never output and breaks on any edit above the symbol; symbols.id is an autoincrement rebuilt on reindex; the only content hash is per file.

title: Record the git commit the index reflects
summary: The meta table only holds repo_root, index_exclude, index_include_generated and index_include_large_files (index/index.go:368, 608-614). Nothing records which commit, or whether the tree was dirty, when the index was last refreshed, so a saved blast radius from `impact` or `changed` cannot be dated or re-checked later.

title: Consolidate builders and retire dead code
summary: Audit findings #9 and #11. Merge repeated result construction and retire code that has no useful work, while preserving public behavior.
